description: Defines a Flutter widget for selecting a size option in a product detail page, including the display of size buttons with active state styling.

classes.name: SelectedSize
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of sizes for selection and highlights the selected size.

classes.name: SizeButton
classes.description: A stateless widget representing an individual size button with active state styling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for both SelectedSize and SizeButton widgets.
